Personal Windows fork changes: separate service identity, pipe names, persistent
state root, execution lock, and service executable name for Clash Verge Auto Chain.
This directory does not implement Claude egress protection by itself.
Do not replace these binaries with unmodified upstream prebuilt service binaries.
